name: OpenVDB Volume Data Source
definition: A Mitsuba plugin that provides volume rendering capabilities by loading and sampling data from OpenVDB files. It implements the VolumeDataSource interface to allow ray marching through volumetric data stored in the OpenVDB format.
summary: The OpenVDB Volume Data Source is a Mitsuba plugin that enables ray marching through OpenVDB sparse voxel data, distinguished by its integration into the rendering pipeline's caching system and specific handling of coordinate transforms.
